desc.singulo.accelerator_controller: Controls a square ring 8–32 wide. Bigger rings are faster and yield more monopoles.
desc.singulo.accelerator_tube: Tube segment of the Particle Accelerator ring.
desc.singulo.afterglow_wings: Wings of crystal feathers born from the Last Archivist's light. Wear them on your chest to glide; sneak while gliding to beat them and surge ahead. No fall damage.
desc.singulo.android_armor_plate: One fitted to a guard android works as its chestplate (+8 armor, +2 toughness). Takes armor enchantments.
desc.singulo.android_backpack_upgrade: Fitted to a guard android, it adds 24 inventory slots (4 rows of 6). The android wears it on its back.
desc.singulo.android_barrier_glass: Glass that only androids cannot pass. Players and other creatures go straight through. Joins seamlessly with the same glass next to it.
desc.singulo.android_barrier_glass_patte: Patterned glass that only androids cannot pass.
desc.singulo.android_battery_upgrade: Fitted to a guard android, each one raises its full charge by 50% (up to two). A battery pack appears on its waist for each.
desc.singulo.android_beret: A beret for an android's head. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_book: A book an android holds while idle. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_bouquet: A bouquet an android holds while idle. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_cape: A cape hanging from an android's shoulders that flutters as it walks. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_capsule: A glass capsule holding a dormant white android body.
desc.singulo.android_charger: While you carry it, a following android comes close and recharges as it walks with you (30 full charges when full). Right-click a block that supplies power to charge it.
desc.singulo.android_delivery_port: Androids bring finished orders here (choose it as the destination when ordering). A 27-slot box you can name in its screen; it moves its contents into adjacent chests by itself.
desc.singulo.android_dual_tank_upgrade: Only works when Mekanism is installed. In the tank slot it gives two liquid tanks and two chemical tanks (16,000 mB each; the same total as a Tank Upgrade), for work that uses both. Glass tubes and gas cylinders show at its waist. It cannot be removed while they hold anything.
desc.singulo.android_factory_print_unit: Fitted in an Android Assembly Station's print unit slot, printing takes half the time and power, and repairs on the station run twice as fast.
desc.singulo.android_felling_upgrade: Lets a guard android do felling steps on procedure cards (cutting whole trees and replanting saplings), like a diamond axe. Takes Efficiency, Fortune and Silk Touch.
desc.singulo.android_gas_tank_upgrade: Only works when Mekanism is installed. In the tank slot it gives two tanks for Mekanism chemicals (gases, infuse types, pigments, slurries; 32,000 mB each, one chemical per tank), so work can carry chemicals from the stockpile to machines. Gas cylinders show at its waist. Click a tank in the screen with a chemical tank to fill or draw. It cannot be removed while they hold anything.
desc.singulo.android_gate_glass: Glass that only androids can pass; solid for everything else. Joins seamlessly with the same glass next to it.
desc.singulo.android_gate_glass_patterne: Patterned glass that only androids can pass.
desc.singulo.android_hair_flower: A flower hair ornament worn on the right side of an android's head. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_headdress: A frilled headdress for an android's head. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_kit: A set of parts and shell. An Android Assembly Station uses one each time it prints an android.
desc.singulo.android_memory_axe: A compact crystal memory holding the design of the Axe Android prototyped in the underground android laboratory. Dropped by the laboratory overseer. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_bit: A compact crystal memory holding the design of the Bit Android prototyped in the underground android laboratory. Dropped by the laboratory overseer. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_blade: A compact crystal memory with a reader, holding the design of the Blade Android. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_saber: A compact crystal memory with a reader, holding the design of the Saber Android. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_memory_whip: A compact crystal memory with a reader, holding the design of the Whip Android. Put it in an Android Assembly Station to print that design (it is not used up).
desc.singulo.android_mining_upgrade: Fitted to a guard android, it lets the android do mining work (like a diamond pickaxe). Takes Efficiency, Fortune and Silk Touch.
desc.singulo.android_production_upgrade: Fitted in an Android Assembly Station, it prints and looks after up to two androids. Only one can charge on top at a time; the other waits beside it and takes its turn.
desc.singulo.android_recipe_rack: A six-row rack. Put a Work Location Card on the left of a row and up to eight recipe cards on the right, and they can be ordered as recipes made at that location.
desc.singulo.android_repair_kit: Kept in a guard android's inventory, one is used to restore half its health when it gets hurt (when they run out, it returns to its station).
desc.singulo.android_ribbon: A ribbon tied at the back of an android's head. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_scarf: A scarf wrapped around an android's neck. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_station: Prints one guard android (two with a Production Upgrade) from a compact crystal memory, an android kit and power, and reprints it with a new kit if it falls. Set how it moves and at what health it comes back to repair and recharge.
desc.singulo.android_supply_port: Connects the storage next to it (chests and the like) and fluid tanks as the work stockpile. Androids take materials here and put what they make back.
desc.singulo.android_tank_upgrade: Gives a guard android two tanks for liquids and gases (32,000 mB each, one fluid per tank), so work can carry fluids from the stockpile to machines. The tanks show at its waist. It cannot be removed while they hold anything.
desc.singulo.android_teacup: A teacup an android holds while idle. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_transfer_upgrade: Fitted in an Android Assembly Station's upgrade slot, an android that falls or is dismantled sends its inventory (repair kits, armor plate, upgrades and carried items) to the station instead of dropping it, and the next android it prints carries it.
desc.singulo.android_umbrella: An umbrella an android holds up while idle. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_waist_ribbon: A large bow tied at the back of an android's waist. Goes in the decoration page. Dye it with dyes on a crafting table.
desc.singulo.android_work_console: Brings together the supply ports, delivery ports and recipe racks linked to it with a Work Location Card, takes orders and hands the work to nearby androids. It works as a supply port and a delivery port itself, and its Record tab writes recipes onto recipe cards. Orders need every material in stock.
desc.singulo.android_workbench: Where androids make crafting-table recipes, four times as fast as a vanilla crafting table. Record it on the Work Location Card in a recipe rack.
desc.singulo.archive_terminal: Copies ruin records onto data cards, restores degraded parts and decodes crystal memories.
desc.singulo.archivist_halo: The halo the Last Archivist wore. It is still quietly warm and faintly whispers in an old tongue.
desc.singulo.area_card: Sneak-use two blocks to record the area between them as corners (up to 128 blocks per side; one card is split off a stack). Sneak-use again to record anew; sneak-use on nothing to clear it. Used on the Routes page of the work console and assembly station for the area a waypoint covers and for no-entry zones.
desc.singulo.artificial_star_core: A star core that replaces nether stars.
desc.singulo.awakening_echo_core: A sentinel core overlaid with echo-shard records. Use it on the guardian core in a Research Building to call the Awakened Echo Sentinel: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster moves, an extra echo, and it re-projects broken projectors when enraged. Victory adds an overclock chip and more to the usual drops.
desc.singulo.awakening_ergosphere_core: A Chapter of the Vortex spun up again with jet condensate and H-Condensate. Use it on the guardian core of a Sunken Reactor Sector to call the Awakened Ergosphere Leviathan: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster swimming, chained dives and a breath that tracks you.
desc.singulo.awakening_foundry_core: Precision actuators charged with singularity power to reawaken the overseer's command chain. Use it on the guardian core in an Android Laboratory to wake the Awakened Foundry: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster moves, and it reprints its broken production lines once when enraged.
desc.singulo.awakening_gravity_core: A degenerate nucleus charged with singularity power. Use it on the guardian core in a Culture Facility to call the Awakened Gravity Remnant: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, more debris, a wider and stronger gravity well, and chained slams. Victory adds an overclock chip and more to the usual drops.
desc.singulo.awakening_record_core: A record of the defeated warden, reforged with singularity power. Use it on the Seal Console in the final lab to wake the Awakened Horizon Warden: 2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster moves. Victory yields overclock chips and more.
desc.singulo.basic_circuit: The brain of every early machine.
desc.singulo.basic_frame: The frame almost every machine is built on.
desc.singulo.bh_container: A vessel for holding a tiny black hole.
desc.singulo.black_hole_bomb: Thrown: opens a tiny black hole that swallows its surroundings.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_glass: See-through, as hard and blast-resistant as the Black Reinforced Panel. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_panel: A black panel as blast-resistant as obsidian. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.black_star_glass: Black Reinforced Glass with a four-pointed star.
desc.singulo.blank_data_card: An empty card for copying records in the Archive Terminal.
desc.singulo.builder_wand: Creative only. Instantly builds the multiblock of a controller. Sneak to change size.
desc.singulo.bulkhead: A heavy door sealing the laboratory core section. It opens when facility power returns. Unbreakable.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity: Creates negative energy between mirrors to make exotic matter.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_controller: Middle of the front, second layer, of the 5×5×5 cavity.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_frame: Frame along the cavity edges (not the corners).
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_pump: Vacuum pumps on the eight corners.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_shield: Magnetic shields either side of each window.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_wall: Vessel wall; any can be swapped for an I/O port.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_window: Middle of each side; shows the vacuum between the mirrors.
desc.singulo.catalyst_stabilizer: Use with a catalyst in your other hand to double its remaining life. Once per catalyst.
desc.singulo.catalytic_reactor: Makes catalysts, starting with the muon catalyst.
desc.singulo.ceramic_substrate: A fired ceramic board for circuits.
desc.singulo.coffee_maker: The laboratory break-room coffee maker. Use it: it still works.
desc.singulo.cold_atoms: Atoms cooled close to absolute zero.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_1: Nine units of mass pressed together. The start of the compression chain.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_2: Nine Lv1 blocks (eight if mixed). Fuel for the Degenerate Furnace.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_2_mixed: Lv1 made from 3+ kinds of blocks needs only 8 for Lv2.
desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_1: A compressed block made only of metals.
desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_2: Denser metal block, used for artificial star cores.
desc.singulo.compressor: Presses plates. In mass mode it turns any item into mass for compressed blocks and pellets.
desc.singulo.confinement_ring: A ring that cages black holes and singularities in a magnetic field, its meteoric-iron core gathering the flux.
desc.singulo.control_unit: A restored ancient control unit with limited uses.
desc.singulo.coolant_cartridge: A steel canister holding 100 mB of liquid nitrogen. Lets the Precision Assembler build cryogenic parts such as quantum computing modules.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_casing: Cooling Tower wall. Panels on the 5×5 rings can be swapped for I/O ports.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_controller: Goes in the middle of the front, second layer. The tower is 7–15 high; taller is faster.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_coolant_band: Coolant bands around the waist, every third layer.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_extension: Build the tower 10+ high to liquefy helium.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_glass: Window in the tower waist; the cores glow blue inside.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_grate: Grate closing the top; the vapour escapes through it.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_rim: The 5×5 rim at the top of the tower.
desc.singulo.copper_wire: Tier 1 power cable. Loses a little energy over distance.
desc.singulo.core_controller: Placed 5 below the core centre. Ignite the reactor from its screen.
desc.singulo.cosmic_muon_collector: Collects cosmic-ray muons for free high up under open sky.
desc.singulo.creative_catalyst: Creative only. A catalyst that never wears out. Right-click to change its tier.
desc.singulo.creative_energy_source: Creative only. Endless power pushed into every neighbour.
desc.singulo.cryogenic_cooling_tower: A multiblock that liquefies nitrogen from the air, and helium too once it is 10 or more blocks tall.
desc.singulo.culture_data: A record from the culture facility.
desc.singulo.data_card_observation_log: A copy of an observation log, usable in recipes.
desc.singulo.data_card_quantum_fragment: A copy of a quantum data fragment.
desc.singulo.decoded_record: Right-click to read it and add the next ancient record to your handbook.
desc.singulo.deep_sea_collector: On the sea floor, water pressure presses minerals into Pressure Crystals. Works from 16 blocks deep; fastest at 48 (one a minute). No power needed.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor: Crushes matter into degenerate shells and reactor parts.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_anvil: The anvil at the centre of the Degenerate Compactor floor. It takes the blows of the ram from above.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_contro: Middle of the front, second layer, of the 5×5×5 press.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_frame: Frame along the 12 edges of the press.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_plate: Plating; any plate can be swapped for an I/O port.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_ram: Top centre; hammers down onto the anvil.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_vent: Cooling vents along the top row of each side.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_window: Middle of each side; watch the ram strike.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace: A large generator burning Lv2 blocks: 5 MFE/t on time crystals with default settings (25% on BE catalysts).
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_controll: Goes in the middle of a side, second layer from the bottom.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_fin: Radiators on either side of each furnace window.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_frame: The heavy frame along the 12 edges of the 5×5×7 furnace.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_piston: Sits in the middle of the top and bottom faces and crushes the fuel.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_shell: Furnace plating. Any panel can be swapped for a Multiblock I/O Port.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_tube: Copper pipes standing in the four inner corners of the furnace.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_window: The middle column of each furnace side; shows the glowing core.
desc.singulo.degenerate_nucleus: The uncollapsed gravity knot left at the heart of the Gravity Remnant. Used for the Singularity Encapsulator, Singularity Seed and Graviton Manipulator.
desc.singulo.degenerate_precursor: Compressed blocks pressed to the edge of degeneracy around a pressure-crystal seed. Shells need less rock with it.
desc.singulo.degraded_anomaly_sample: A sample from the final lab.
desc.singulo.degraded_cold_atom_trap: Restore it in the Laser Cooler.
desc.singulo.degraded_control_unit: A degraded part. Restore it in the Archive Terminal.
desc.singulo.degraded_time_crystal_seed: A seed found in the Culture Facility. Restore it to grow time crystals.
desc.singulo.desk_monitor: A small monitor from a laboratory desk. Only its screen glows faintly.
desc.singulo.dimensional_pocket: Right-click to open your own 27-slot storage from anywhere. The contents survive death.
desc.singulo.dormant_singularity_seed: Guarded by the Horizon Warden. Awaken it in the encapsulator.
desc.singulo.echo_chapter: A passage of records left behind when the Awakened Echo Sentinel unravels. It looks like part of a page. Bound with other chapters, it might be readable.
desc.singulo.echo_projector: Projects the Echo Sentinel. The more projectors remain, the less damage the sentinel takes. Breaks by hand.
desc.singulo.echo_resonator: Copies echo shards using a template shard.
desc.singulo.electrolyzer: Splits water into hydrogen and oxygen.
desc.singulo.emergency_light: Laboratory emergency light. It glows red only while main power is down.
desc.singulo.entangled_element: Always made in pairs. Used in detectors and links.
desc.singulo.ergosphere_chapter: A passage of records that surfaces after the Ergosphere Leviathan sinks: the rest of the second reactor's log. Also used for the Awakened Ergosphere Core.
desc.singulo.ergosphere_ring: Extracts exotic matter from a fast-spinning core.
desc.singulo.event_horizon_shield: Protects a 32-block radius from explosions, griefing and hostile spawns.
desc.singulo.exotic_matter: Matter with negative energy density. Fuels gravity tech.
desc.singulo.explorer_compass: Right-click to point at the nearest ruin of the chosen kind. Sneak-use to change the kind.
desc.singulo.extraction_port: Power/fuel port for the reactor. Replaces any ring shell block (not the gyro drives).
desc.singulo.facility_light: Laboratory ceiling light. It shines white only while the facility has power.
desc.singulo.factory_conveyor: A belt conveyor from an old-civilization factory. While running, it carries whatever stands on it. The Foundry Overseer runs them during its fight.
desc.singulo.factory_line: A printing bay along the walls of the Android Laboratory AI core. While running it shields the Foundry Overseer and prints mass-produced androids. Breakable by hand.
desc.singulo.focusing_magnet: Magnet for the ring corners and at least 1/4 of the ring.
desc.singulo.fulgurite: Natural high-purity quartz glass fused by lightning. Used to make optical lattice substrates.
desc.singulo.fulgurite_block: Sand fused by a lightning strike. Break it for fulgurite.
desc.singulo.genesis_core: The heart of an engine that makes a universe from energy. Surround it with 8 frames and 12 pylons, use a Primordial Seed and pour in 1.5 TFE to begin. Once born, the universe turns power into mass (items).
desc.singulo.genesis_frame: Placed level with the Genesis Core in an octagon three blocks out (four on the axes, four on the 2-2 diagonals).
desc.singulo.genesis_pylon: Stacked three high on each diagonal frame of the Genesis Engine; they focus power into the newborn universe.
desc.singulo.gravitational_containment_t: The only tank that holds dark matter. Keeps its contents when broken.
desc.singulo.gravitational_wave_detector: Points toward the nearest gravitational anomaly.
desc.singulo.graviton_manipulator: The full gravity tool. Hold left-click to use; while levitating, charge with right-click and release to throw.
desc.singulo.gravity_boots: No fall damage. Jump while touching a wall in mid-air to kick off it (three times before landing).
desc.singulo.gravity_chapter: A passage of records left in the collapse of the Awakened Gravity Remnant, etched with a memory of weight. Bound with other chapters, it might be readable.
desc.singulo.gravity_field_stabilizer: A component of the core controller.
desc.singulo.gravity_panel_receiver: Powers every gravity panel connected to it. When power runs short, only the nearest panels it can pay for work. Right-click to see how many are active.
desc.singulo.guardian_core: The seal in the floor of a ruin boss room. It wakes the ruin's guardian when a challenger enters. Unbreakable.
desc.singulo.gyro_drive: Placed where the reactor rings cross.
desc.singulo.halo_collector: Gathers dark matter near a running core.
desc.singulo.handbook: Right-click to open. Explains goals, machines, multiblocks and shows your progress.
desc.singulo.hawking_collector: Collects one H-Condensate every 5 minutes while the core is light (catalyst mode; harvest mode keeps it there).
desc.singulo.hawking_condensate: Condensed Hawking radiation. An ingredient of the Singularity Core.
desc.singulo.heat_exchange_core: Heat exchangers stacked up the middle of the tower.
desc.singulo.high_gravity_panel: When powered, standing on it raises your gravity 2.5x until you next land. Joins visually with its neighbours.
desc.singulo.holo_projector: Use on a multiblock controller to project its shape and list missing blocks. Sneak-use to change size.
desc.singulo.horizon_bus: The tier 5 cable, needed to ignite the reactor.
desc.singulo.horizon_chapter: A passage of records found in the Awakened Horizon Warden's wreck, naming what the warden was guarding. Bound with other chapters, it might be readable.
desc.singulo.impact_generator_panel: Landing on it causes no fall damage. Stores 1,000 FE per block fallen (up to 20,000 FE) and powers connected gravity panels.
desc.singulo.inertial_control_gauntlet: Hold right-click to levitate or pull one small mob. Sneak-use to switch modes.
desc.singulo.inertial_stabilizer: Stops explosions from breaking blocks within 16 blocks.
desc.singulo.intact_ruin_glass: An intact ancient window, as tough and blast-resistant as a ruin panel.
desc.singulo.jet_collector: Collects jet condensate from the reactor.
desc.singulo.keraunos_tower: Builds up 1,000,000 FE and hurls artificial lightning at the nearest lightning rod within 16 blocks. Sand under the rod turns into fulgurite. Three firing modes: manual, redstone and auto (sneak-right-click to switch).
desc.singulo.kiln: Fires ceramics and boards. Oxygen makes it hotter.
desc.singulo.lab_frame: Dark steel framing used for the laboratory's pillars and door frames.
desc.singulo.lab_glass: Clear partition glass from the laboratory.
desc.singulo.lab_panel: White wall panelling from the underground android laboratory. The androids still polish it spotless.
desc.singulo.lab_panel_lined: Laboratory panelling with a blue-grey band.
desc.singulo.lab_terminal: A terminal left in the laboratory. Use it to read the records left behind.
desc.singulo.laser_cooler: Laser-cools atoms into cold atoms, lattices and condensates.
desc.singulo.low_gravity_panel: When powered, standing on it cuts your gravity to a fifth until you next land (less fall damage too). Joins visually with its neighbours.
desc.singulo.magnetic_bottle: A bottle that traps strangelets in a magnetic field. Use it on leaking strange matter to contain and collect it.
desc.singulo.magnetic_key: Opens or seals a magnetic-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.magnetic_monopole: A theoretical particle born in about 1 of 1000 collisions.
desc.singulo.mass_pellet: Packed mass fuel for the P-Reactor.
desc.singulo.meteor_compass: Right-click to point at the nearest meteorite core not yet mined. Once that core is mined, the needle spins again.
desc.singulo.meteoric_iron_chunk: Natural iron-nickel alloy inside a meteorite. Mine it (iron pickaxe or better) for raw meteoric iron. Found only in meteor craters.
desc.singulo.meteoric_iron_ingot: A strongly magnetic natural iron-nickel alloy, used for magnet pole pieces, magnetic keys and confinement rings.
desc.singulo.meteorite_core: A fused lump of meteoric iron and stardust, one at the heart of each meteorite. Mine it (iron pickaxe or better) for raw meteoric iron and stardust. The Meteor Compass points to it.
desc.singulo.meteorite_crust: The burnt, melted shell of a crater meteorite. Only shells still in their crater slowly grow stardust clusters.
desc.singulo.metric_drive: Switch between low gravity, flight and high gravity.
desc.singulo.micro_black_hole: Holds a tiny black hole. Bends light around it.
desc.singulo.mirror_plate: Inner 3×3 of the cavity top and bottom: two facing mirrors.
desc.singulo.monopole_upgrade: Insert into a machine's monopole slot: ×2 speed and 50% better power efficiency.
desc.singulo.multiblock_port: Replaces a plain shell panel of a multiblock (not frames or functional parts; for the accelerator, either side of the controller). Cables and pipes reach the controller, and outputs and generated power are pushed out automatically.
desc.singulo.muon_bundle: A bundle of muons, the base of muon catalysts.
desc.singulo.muon_catalyst: Tier 2 catalyst with a lifetime. Leaves a spent catalyst when used up.
desc.singulo.neutrino_observatory: Keeps scanning a wide area and shows ores and ruins to nearby players. Use to toggle.
desc.singulo.neutrino_scanner: Shows the outlines of nearby ruin blocks and ores through terrain for 10 seconds. Uses power. Sensitivity modules reveal deeper ores.
desc.singulo.observation_log: A record from observation posts. Copy it onto data cards.
desc.singulo.optical_lattice_substrate: Atoms held in a lattice of light.
desc.singulo.overclock_chip: Goes in a machine's upgrade slot: ×3 speed for ×4 power per tick. Cannot be combined with a monopole.
desc.singulo.paper_stack: Papers left piled on a desk.
desc.singulo.particle_accelerator: Collides particles into muon bundles and rare monopoles.
desc.singulo.penrose_reactor: Draws energy from a spinning black hole.
desc.singulo.phase_sync_plate: Imprints cold-atom oscillations on an optical lattice. Phase-locks time crystals so they grow in 12 minutes.
desc.singulo.power_conduit: A conduit carrying power from the central reactor. It glows cyan once power returns.
desc.singulo.precision_actuator: A precise drive unit from the production lines of an underground android laboratory. Dropped by the Foundry Overseer and found in the laboratory vault and research chests. Used for the Factory Print Unit and the Awakened Foundry Core.
desc.singulo.precision_assembler: Assembles most parts and machines from tier 2 on.
desc.singulo.pressure_crystal: An extremely hard blue crystal formed under deep-sea pressure. Used for the compactor anvil and degenerate precursors.
desc.singulo.pressure_hull: The thick steel shell around the whole laboratory. Sealed and unbreakable until the overseer AI falls, and harder than obsidian even after.
desc.singulo.primordial_seed: A seed made by running the ignition log in the Chapter of the Vortex backwards. Use it on a Genesis Core to begin the birth of a universe.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_light: A white panel with a softly glowing strip. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_panel: An unweathered white panel from deep ruins. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_pillar: A white pillar from deep ruins. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_tiles: Unweathered white tiles from deep ruins. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.probe_station: Sends probes to discovered ruins to fetch loot.
desc.singulo.procedure_card: Records up to eight steps and what they produce, in the procedure mode of a work console's Record tab. Steps can insert, extract, mine, harvest, fell, breed, shear, milk, cull or use a block (levers and buttons). The places are stored on the card, so it works in a recipe rack row without a Work Location Card. Mining needs a Mining Upgrade and felling a Felling Upgrade.
desc.singulo.quantum_heat_engine: Generates power from the quantum effects of a catalyst. Higher-tier catalysts give more output.
desc.singulo.quantum_key: Opens or seals a quantum-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.raw_meteoric_iron: Smelt it in a blast furnace into meteoric iron.
desc.singulo.reactor_console: Central reactor control panel. Use it to restart the reactor and restore facility power.
desc.singulo.reactor_core: The central reactor core. It glows bright cyan once power returns.
desc.singulo.reactor_mass_alarm: Replaces a shell on a reactor ring. Emits redstone when the core reaches its mass limit, stronger near collapse.
desc.singulo.reactor_shell: Shell of the reactor's three rings.
desc.singulo.reactor_stabilizer: Coils at the 45° points of the reactor rings.
desc.singulo.recipe_card: Record a recipe on it in a work console's Record tab and place it in a recipe rack. Sneak-use on nothing to clear it. Hold Shift to see what it makes.
desc.singulo.record_fragment: An ancient storage medium: records etched by light inside glass. Read it in the Archive Terminal to add it to the handbook.
desc.singulo.reinforced_ruin_glass: A window set into the containment pillars of the Sunken Reactor Sector, built to survive the reactor's blasts. Very hard and blast-proof.
desc.singulo.ruin_android_fabricator: Prints androids onto its bed and sends them out. Defeat them all to get a compact crystal memory of their design.
desc.singulo.ruin_cache: Holds ruin loot and refills some days after it is emptied (not if moved). Hoppers and pipes cannot take from it.
desc.singulo.ruin_glass: A cracked ancient window, as tough and blast-resistant as a ruin panel.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp: An ancient lamp that still glows.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_amber: An amber ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_crimson: A crimson ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_verdant: A green ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_violet: A violet ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.scanner_module_2: Use with a Neutrino Scanner in your other hand, or on an observatory, to reach sensitivity 2: gold, diamond and emerald show up.
desc.singulo.scanner_module_3: Raises sensitivity to 3: ancient debris and ores that need a diamond pickaxe show up.
desc.singulo.seal_console: The seal of the Final Lab. Touch it to wake the Horizon Warden.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_1: Opens with a Magnetic Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_2: Opens with a Quantum Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_3: Opens with a Temporal Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_4: Opens with a Singularity Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_record: Right-click to read it and add a sealed ancient record to your handbook.
desc.singulo.sentinel_core: The record crystal from the Echo Sentinel's chest. Built into the Echo Resonator, Time Crystal Incubator and Probe Station.
desc.singulo.server_rack: A laboratory server. Its lights blink while powered.
desc.singulo.settings_card: Copies a machine's settings to another.
desc.singulo.shield_permit: Put it in a shield tower: only registered players may build, break or take items inside. In an Android Assembly Station, registered players may also control the android. Use to register yourself; use on a player to register them and you. Anyone can break the emitter crown.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_body: Corners of the 3×3 body and the base of the spire.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_coil: Inner 3×3 of the upper plinth layer.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_core: The brain of the Event Horizon Shield Tower. Goes in the front middle of the second plinth layer.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_crown: The top of the tower; the dome is cast from here.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_plinth: The 5×5 two-layer plinth; its upper edge takes I/O ports.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_waveguide: Middle of each body face; shows the rising energy.
desc.singulo.singularity_key: Opens or seals a singularity-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.singularity_seed: Becomes a black hole core when ignited.
desc.singulo.smes_cell: Superconducting magnetic energy storage that holds a large amount of power. Right-click to open its screen.
desc.singulo.spent_bose_condensate_catal: A used-up BE Condensate Catalyst. About 25% can be recovered as a lower-tier catalyst.
desc.singulo.spent_singularity_core: A used-up Singularity Core. About 25% can be recovered as a lower-tier catalyst.
desc.singulo.spent_time_crystal_catalyst: A used-up Time Crystal Catalyst. About 25% can be recovered as a lower-tier catalyst.
desc.singulo.stardust: Cosmic grains carrying rare isotopes. The raw material for cold atoms.
desc.singulo.stardust_cluster: Crystals of cosmic grains that grow on meteorite crust. Break them for stardust.
desc.singulo.steel_blend: A mix of iron and coal. Smelt it in a blast furnace to get steel.
desc.singulo.steel_ingot: The basic structural metal. Steel from other mods works too.
desc.singulo.steel_plate: Pressed steel used for casings and parts. Steel plates from other mods (c:plates/steel) work too.
desc.singulo.strange_matter: Ultra-dense matter left by strangelets. Worth 100 mass and usable for degenerate shells.
desc.singulo.strangelet: Converts nearby blocks into strange matter. Contain it with a Magnetic Bottle.
desc.singulo.striped_ruin_panel: Ancient panel with a long-dead light band.
desc.singulo.superconducting_coil: A zero-resistance coil, core of tier 2 tech.
desc.singulo.survey_glasses: Worn on the head (use it, or put it in the helmet slot). While worn, the places recorded on the area card or work location card in your hand are outlined (with only the first corner of an area recorded, the area up to the block you look at is previewed). The icons over working androids, showing what they are doing, are only visible while wearing them.
desc.singulo.temporal_key: Opens or seals a temporal-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.terminus_record: The four chapters bound back together with singularity power: the last page. Use it on the Seal Console of the Final Lab to wake what slept in the time field. Leave and the record is returned.
desc.singulo.thermocouple_module: Turns a temperature difference into electricity.
desc.singulo.thermoelectric_generator: Place it between something hot and something cold to generate power. Your first generator. Magma block + blue ice gives about 76 FE/t without melting.
desc.singulo.time_crystal_catalyst: Tier 4 catalyst used by most advanced devices.
desc.singulo.time_crystal_incubator: Grows time crystal catalysts. Underpowering lowers their purity.
desc.singulo.time_crystal_module: Two thirds of a fresh time crystal's life (30 minutes with default settings) sealed into a stackable part. Built into the Core Controller, Singularity Encapsulator, Shield Tower Core and other equipment. Crystals with less life left than that (used or low-purity ones) cannot be cut. Lifetime settings and presets scale the amount.
desc.singulo.tipler_bearing: Top and bottom centre; carries the cylinder axle.
desc.singulo.tipler_core: Middle of the front, second layer, of the 5×5×9 housing.
desc.singulo.tipler_cylinder: Speeds up time within 16 blocks: machines and crops nearby run twice as fast.
desc.singulo.tipler_frame: Frame along the 12 edges of the housing.
desc.singulo.tipler_holder: Either side of each window, middle layer.
desc.singulo.tipler_housing: Housing; any panel can be swapped for an I/O port.
desc.singulo.tipler_window: Five-high slit in each side; shows the spinning cylinder.
desc.singulo.trash_bin: A laboratory trash bin. The androids empty it every day.
desc.singulo.unfired_ceramic: Clay, sand, Nether quartz and bone meal, ready to be fired into white ceramic.
desc.singulo.vending_machine: A laboratory drinks vending machine (two blocks tall). Use it: sold out.
desc.singulo.void_collector: Place it in the End over open void to gather one Void Dust a minute. Needs no power.
desc.singulo.void_dust: Dust condensed from the fluctuations of empty space, gathered only above the End void. Steadies space in singularity tech.
desc.singulo.white_ceramic_composite: The white ceramic used for casings and circuit boards.
desc.singulo.white_glass_panel: A see-through panel in the White Panel style.
desc.singulo.white_light_panel: A white panel that glows brightly (light 15).
desc.singulo.white_panel: A clean, seamless white panel for your own buildings.
desc.singulo.white_star_glass_panel: A see-through white panel with a four-pointed star.
desc.singulo.work_location_card: Sneak-use on a block to record its position (one card is split off a stack). Sneak-use on nothing to clear it. Use a card holding a work console on a supply port, delivery port or recipe rack to link it. Hold Shift to see the recorded block.
desc.singulo.worldline_anchor_advanced: Advanced chunk loader. Embedding a Singularity Core makes it free and maximal.
desc.singulo.worldline_anchor_small: Keeps nearby chunks loaded while fed a catalyst.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator: Creates a pair of wormhole mouths from 100 MFE/t for 10 s.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_coil: Equator, either side of each window.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_core: Front middle of the second ring from the bottom of the sphere.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_focuser: Top and bottom centre of the sphere.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_port: Replaces a generator shell. Feeds power to the core and pushes finished mouths out.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_shell: The outer shell of the Wormhole Generator sphere. Any shell block can be replaced with a multiblock I/O port.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_window: Middle of each face at the equator; shows the vortex.
desc.singulo.wormhole_mouth: Links to its twin. Runs on exotic matter; when it runs dry it closes and waits for more. Stays open for 5 minutes without fuel when first placed.
desc.singulo.wormhole_mouth_casing: An open frame that holds a stabilized throat. One per wormhole mouth.
desc.singulo.wormhole_port: Within 8 blocks of a mouth, links machines to the port with the same number (0-127) near the twin mouth. A mouth runs 8, 32 or 128 ports by throat size, nearest first. Glows while active.
desc.singulo.wormhole_stabilizer: Stabilizes an unstable wormhole mouth with exotic matter so that it can be placed.
ending.singulo.archivist: — The Archivist's voice: "Beyond the last page. Thank you for letting me read it."
ending.singulo.line.1: Once, a civilization tried to turn all mass into energy.
ending.singulo.line.2: The reactor granted that wish: the cities, the mountains, the sea. Only the anomaly and the records remained.
ending.singulo.line.3: You read those records and lit the same fire. And you never let go of the hand that stops the feed.
ending.singulo.line.4: And now the energy has become mass again, then stars, then a galaxy.
ending.singulo.line.5: Look up at the night sky. That light is the universe you made.
ending.singulo.supporter_controls: ← / → to browse supporters · Esc to close
gui.singulo.anchor.confirm_embed: Use again to embed. It cannot be removed
gui.singulo.android.chem.hint: Click with a chemical tank (Mekanism) or similar to fill or draw
gui.singulo.android.decor.0.hint: Ribbon, hair flower, beret or headdress
gui.singulo.android.decor.2.hint: Paperback, bouquet, teacup or umbrella (held only while idle)
gui.singulo.android.decor.dye: Dye them with dyes on a crafting table
gui.singulo.android.follow.hint: Click to switch between "Follow only" (never fights) and "Follow & escort" (fights nearby enemies). Also changes the station setting.
gui.singulo.android.log.alarm: Spotted a group of %2$s (%1$s and others) and raised the alarm
gui.singulo.android.log.empty.1: Defeated enemies and alarms show up here
gui.singulo.android.say.idle.6: I'll do my best today too!
gui.singulo.android.tank.hint: Click with a bucket or other container to fill or draw
gui.singulo.android.work.hint: Whether this android may be given work (automation). When off, it is never offered for work.
gui.singulo.android_station.escort.hint: While following, it also fights enemies near you.
While following, it only tags along and never fights (not even when hit).
gui.singulo.android_station.leader.hint: Click to change whom it follows (when that player is away it follows the owner, or else the nearest registered player).
gui.singulo.android_station.locked: You are not on this station's permit
gui.singulo.android_station.mode.0.hint: Waits by the station and fights enemies that come close.
gui.singulo.android_station.mode.1.hint: Roams within 16 blocks of the station and fights the enemies it finds.
gui.singulo.android_station.mode.2.hint: Follows its owner (the buttons below choose whether it fights nearby enemies). Recharges while walking with you if you carry a wireless charger.
gui.singulo.android_station.mode.3.hint: Walks the route below (Work Location Cards) in order and fights enemies nearby. Calls idle allies when a fight starts, and when it spots a group of enemies or a boss, the station gives a redstone signal and the owner is told.
gui.singulo.android_station.patrol.dwell: How long to stop and look around at each point. Click to change
gui.singulo.android_station.patrol.night: Patrol only at night (waiting by the station in the day) or all the time. Click to switch
gui.singulo.android_station.patrol.order: After the last point, go back to the first one (Loop) or come back the same way (Back & forth). Click to switch
gui.singulo.android_station.permit.hint: With a shield permit inside, only the owner and registered players can open the station and android screens, and you can choose which of them it follows.
gui.singulo.android_station.permit.membe: Only the owner and %s registered can use it
gui.singulo.android_station.permit.none: No permit: anyone can use it
gui.singulo.android_station.retreat.hint: Below this share of health it returns to the station to repair and recharge.
gui.singulo.android_station.route.hint: Patrol route: place Work Location Cards and the androids visit those places from left to right (up to 8), standing on top of each one to look around.
gui.singulo.android_station.rules.hint: Switch to the page of route rules for patrols (required waypoints and no-entry zones)
gui.singulo.android_station.status.11: An android without a station is nearby
gui.singulo.android_station.status.2: Not enough power (40000 FE to print)
gui.singulo.archivist.death_1: ...I have been dreaming a long dream.
gui.singulo.archivist.death_2: A record is only a record when someone reads it.
gui.singulo.archivist.death_3: Thank you. Never let go of the hand that stops the feed.
gui.singulo.archivist.emerge_2: Then let me show you the last page.
gui.singulo.archivist.halo: The halo unravels into spreading rings... Jump the low ones, crouch under the high ones!
gui.singulo.archivist.phase_2: Do you remember? Every record is here.
gui.singulo.archivist.phase_3: Light and records alike sink into this dark in the end.
gui.singulo.archivist.reset: No challenger remains. The Archivist returns to the time field, leaving the Terminus Record on the console
gui.singulo.archivist.shield_down: The field sealing the chamber unravels.
gui.singulo.archivist.shield_up: A field seals the chamber. No one leaves until it ends.
gui.singulo.archivist.tide: Let me read you the record of weight.
gui.singulo.archivist.tide_final: There is nowhere left to fall.
gui.singulo.archivist.wings: The Last Archivist spreads its six wings...
gui.singulo.archivist.wings_hint: Stand in the shadow of a wing!
gui.singulo.cache.sealed: Sealed by a force field. Defeat this ruin's guardian
gui.singulo.console.awakened: The seal breaks. The Horizon Warden awakens
gui.singulo.console.awakened_defeated: The awakened warden is defeated. Fine parts spill from the wreck
gui.singulo.console.awakened_rematch: The record core resonates. The Awakened Horizon Warden rises
gui.singulo.console.defeated: The warden falls silent. The vault field dissipates
gui.singulo.console.open: The vault is not sealed (use an Awakening Record Core to fight the awakened warden)
gui.singulo.console.reset: No challenger remains. The warden returns to its seal
gui.singulo.device.mouth.dormant: Closed. Add exotic matter to reopen
gui.singulo.device.port.channel_hint: Toggle the seven circles to set the number (0-127). Links to the active port with the same number on the far side
gui.singulo.device.port.inactive: Inactive: the mouth has too many ports
gui.singulo.device.standby.hint: Fuel and catalyst are not used. Resumes when storage falls under 75%.
gui.singulo.device.tank.label: Dark matter
gui.singulo.genesis.birth_1: The light falls into a single point...
gui.singulo.genesis.birth_2: All mass became energy. So now,
gui.singulo.genesis.birth_sky: The newborn galaxy rises into the night sky
gui.singulo.genesis.collapse: The proto-universe nearly collapses. Progress is lost
gui.singulo.genesis.complete: The Genesis Engine can now make mass. Choose an item on the core's screen
gui.singulo.genesis.event.echoes: Echoes of the records are drawn in
gui.singulo.genesis.event.wave: A wave of gravity rises. Brace for the fall
gui.singulo.genesis.formed: The Genesis Engine takes shape. Use a Primordial Seed on the core to begin
gui.singulo.genesis.hint.0: Surround the core with 8 frames and 12 pylons
gui.singulo.genesis.hint.1: Use a Primordial Seed on the core
gui.singulo.genesis.hint.2: Pour in power to grow the kindling
gui.singulo.genesis.hint.3: Keep power up; stop the feed on a surge
gui.singulo.genesis.hint.5: Put an item in the frame to make it
gui.singulo.genesis.kindled: The seed ignites and a universe begins to swell. Keep the upkeep flowing and watch for surges
gui.singulo.genesis.not_synthesizable: The Genesis Engine cannot make that
gui.singulo.genesis.screen.feed_tip: Click to stop or resume the feed
gui.singulo.genesis.screen.feed_tip_stab: While stopped, upkeep still drains the buffer and events still happen. Feeding without enough power raises instability
gui.singulo.genesis.screen.template_tip_: Click with an item to choose it (it is not used up)
Click empty-handed to clear; shift-click items to choose
gui.singulo.genesis.seeded: The seed sinks in. Pour in power to kindle it
gui.singulo.genesis.surge: Surge warning! Stop the feed (the switch on the core screen, or a redstone signal)
gui.singulo.genesis.surge_end: The surge subsides. You may resume the feed
gui.singulo.genesis.unformed: Not formed (surround the core with 8 frames and 12 pylons)
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened.echo_senti: The echoes of the archive take shape. The Echo Sentinel appears
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened.ergosphere: A vortex opens in the dead core. Something small crawls out...
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened.foundry_ov: The production lines start up. The Foundry Overseer wakes
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened.gravity_re: The containment tank shatters. The Gravity Remnant crawls out
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_defeated: The awakened guardian is defeated. Fine fragments spill out
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_rematch.ec: The core resonates. The Awakened Echo Sentinel appears
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_rematch.er: The core resonates. The Awakened Ergosphere Leviathan tears through the vortex
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_rematch.fo: The awakening core resonates. The Awakened Foundry restarts every line
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_rematch.gr: The core resonates. The Awakened Gravity Remnant crawls out
gui.singulo.guardian.defeated.echo_senti: The Echo Sentinel unravels. The vault field dissipates
gui.singulo.guardian.defeated.ergosphere: The Ergosphere Leviathan sinks into the vortex. The vault field dissipates
gui.singulo.guardian.defeated.foundry_ov: The Foundry's eye goes dark. The lines halt and the vault field dissipates
gui.singulo.guardian.defeated.gravity_re: The Gravity Remnant collapses. The vault field dissipates
gui.singulo.guardian.reset.echo_sentinel: No challenger remains. The Echo Sentinel returns to the records
gui.singulo.guardian.reset.ergosphere_le: No challenger remains. The Ergosphere Leviathan returns to the core
gui.singulo.guardian.reset.foundry_overs: No challenger remains. The Foundry halts its lines and powers down
gui.singulo.guardian.reset.gravity_remna: No challenger remains. The Gravity Remnant sinks back into its tank
gui.singulo.guardian.wrong_core: This is not the awakening core for this ruin's guardian
gui.singulo.handbook.no_records: No records decoded yet. Find crystal memories in ruins and decode them in the Archive Terminal.
gui.singulo.handbook.support_hint: Support the author on Ko-fi (opens in your browser)
gui.singulo.handbook.title: Singulo Handbook
gui.singulo.leviathan.ascend: The vortex tears open and a black wyrm rises, its wings a spread of accretion-disk light
gui.singulo.leviathan.molt: The Leviathan shudders. Its reactor-plate scales burst away, baring a skeleton of light
gui.singulo.leviathan.quake: The Leviathan rises and curls up... Jump over the shockwaves!
gui.singulo.leviathan.rift: Lines of light cross the floor... Get off them!
